task: Cold open short-answer HoH-QAs. The service receives only the user's question. All 32 exposed full-corpus dev questions, exact same order, normalized exact match and token F1 as original. Original 96 cold-transfer pages sealed. Prior 96 page subscriptions excluded from any new test.
hypothesis: A relevant revision should predict the user's question specifically because its value changed. Use two versioned source passages to generate query-independent fact cards. Measure the log probability of the incoming question given a genuine edit, a matched no-edit passage pair, and a counterfactual with only the no-edit recurrent state. Test whether the conditional signal helps select sources and current answers beyond ordinary question generation, conventional reranking and matched text-only cards.
retrieval: Qwen generates one hypothetical evidence sentence from the user question alone. Search all 111971 dated evidence pairs with the original question and a weighted expansion. Pool top32 lexical hits for each and prior retrieved candidates; blend lexical rank, Contriever and prior direct result. Test six sources with the same available pool for all follow-up rankers. Current-only and paired cards are generated once per candidate record without the user question. No source page, official question from another row, or reference answer from the data is supplied.
policies: Original open readers (including 23/32 direct generative and extractive). Expanded retrieval + current-only QA. UPR current-only question likelihood. Current-only hypothetical card retrieval and QA. Paired edit cards ranked by embedding and direct feedback from joint question likelihood. Compare matched winner-take-all cards and open evidence-conditioned QA. Conditional change score averages Qwen question log probabilities under hard change and no change. Native ablation replaces only the source recurrent matrices with no-change matrices. Score = mean reciprocal rank of dense/retrieval, card question similarity and unadjusted likelihood; for contrast arms add rank of genuine-vs-null likelihood gain (weight 1). No outputs determine retrieval or operating points.
gate: Confirm a candidate on the untouched 96 cold HoH pages at 9B only after it gains at least 3/32 normalized exact matches over the strongest practical conventional system, with F1 at least as high. Native attribution additionally requires a gain over the otherwise matched text-only and whole-cache options. Report question-independent card, reranking and final inference costs separately; this batch targets accuracy.
budget: One local 4B BF16/CPU batch per phase. Six documents per question, maximum 192 distinct records, 56 tokens per card and 40 per answer. Thirty minutes per phase, one implementation repair. No paid credits.
